provenance: Real NASA FIRMS detections (2127 rows given to the estimate, 266 drawn in the 24 frames) on AWS Terrarium 30m DEM + EOxCloudless 2016 by EOX IT Services GmbH (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) imagery in the terrain pack (an Esri World Imagery (Maxar) overview is the fallback image). The reconstruction is a model estimate from those detections; the frames are the passes NASA's CMR granule list gives over the region, with their geometry. VIIRS detections were kept from the estimate and used only to score it.

definitions.from_hidden_rows: the metrics computed by the scorer from the hidden rows; every other metric is fixed before they are opened
definitions.simulated_names_not_used: names a simulated run's metrics carry that mean nothing on a real run; they are null here, and each entry below says why and where the figure it used to hold is now
definitions.total_reconstructed_frp_peak_mw: the largest total FRP of the estimate over the frames
definitions.mean_cell_q90_halfwidth_mw_km2: mean of 1.645 times the stated cell standard deviation over cells with fire
definitions.raw_modis_rmse_mw_km2: cell RMSE of MODIS painted as observed against the VIIRS detections (backend/eval/metrics.py, cell_rmse)
definitions.reconstructed_rmse_mw_km2: the same for the reconstruction's predicted VIIRS field
definitions.rmse_reduction_pct: (1 - reconstructed / raw) times 100, signed: a negative value means the reconstruction is worse
definitions.empirical_90_coverage_pct: share of scored VIIRS overpasses whose total FRP lies in the stated 90 percent interval
definitions.cells_gained_over_painted_modis_pct: extra VIIRS cells the reconstruction hits beyond painted MODIS, as a share of the cells painted MODIS misses (0 when it hits fewer)
definitions.cloud_override: an input of simulated runs; a real run has no cloud setting
definitions.conformal_q90_radius_mw_km2: no conformal step is applied to a real run; the mean half width of the stated cell interval is mean_cell_q90_halfwidth_mw_km2
definitions.subpixel_viirs_fires_recovered_pct: a simulated-truth notion; the cells gained over painted MODIS against hidden detections are cells_gained_over_painted_modis_pct
definitions.step_2012_raw_ratio: one run says nothing about the 2012 step in the record; the pixel counts are window.modis_pixels_in_box and blind_test.hidden_rows_in_test_box
definitions.step_2012_harmonized_ratio: one run says nothing about the 2012 step in the record; predicted over hidden FRP is blind_test.methods.reconstruction.frp_total.ratio_of_sums
definitions.step_2012_coobs_frames: one run says nothing about the 2012 step in the record; the count is blind_test.scored_overpasses_with_hidden_detections_in_test_box

observer_passes.provenance: Real NASA FIRMS detections (2127 rows given to the estimate, 266 drawn in the 24 frames) on AWS Terrarium 30m DEM + Maxar 2K Ortho. The reconstruction is a model estimate from those detections; the frames are the passes NASA's CMR granule list gives over the region, with their geometry. VIIRS detections were kept from the estimate and used only to score it.

orbit_node_rule.rule: orbit_node is the platform's equator-crossing node on the day side of its sun-synchronous orbit for a day pass (is_day true) and the opposite node for a night pass
orbit_node_rule.note: Terra and Aqua have drifted from their design crossing times; the node direction is unchanged.

observer_passes.geometry_note: FIRMS does not publish a pass's geometry. scan_angle_deg, view_zenith_deg, azimuth_deg, subsat_lon and subsat_lat are worked out from where the region box lies in the swath polygon of the pass, which NASA's CMR granule list gives; no detection is read for them, so a held-out frame has them too. cloud_fraction is not measured (FIRMS rows carry no cloud mask) and is written as 0; granule_cloud_cover_pct is the mean over a whole MODIS granule, about 2,000 km long, and is null for VIIRS.
observer_passes.held_out_frames_note: a frame whose epistemic_regime ends in held_out is a real pass of a hidden platform. It shows the estimate at the time of that pass and nothing observed: no footprint, channel A empty. What the satellite saw is in blind_test.reveal.overpasses, each with the frame it belongs to.
observer_passes.confidence_note: MODIS confidence is the source's 0 to 100 value. VIIRS confidence is a class; the numeric slot holds 15, 55 or 90 for low, nominal, high and the class counts are in each frame's viirs_confidence_classes.

numbers_built_by.note: figures and digests are this build's; another build of numpy gives the same classes, flags and words and figures within 0.08 percent, and other digests (backend/model/numbers_build.py)

hidden_platforms_note: every VIIRS detection of these platforms was kept from the estimate and used only to score it; the list comes from the archive's start dates, not from the hidden rows, less any platform whose rows the cache does not hold for the window (platforms_without_rows_in_the_cache)

window.rule: from the first MODIS overpass with a detection in the box at or after the requested start, the first 24 passes whose swath held the whole box, of every platform, fire or no fire (NASA CMR granule list). MODIS is visible in every kind of run, so a run with VIIRS hidden and a run with nothing hidden play the same passes.
window.chosen_from: MODIS rows for the start and the pass list for the frames; no row of a hidden instrument

hidden_rows.rule: the hidden rows are parted from the visible ones before anything is chosen or built (backend/eval/holdout.py) and opened by the scorer alone
hidden_rows.everything_else: byte for byte the same whatever the hidden rows hold (pipeline_stages durations are wall clock times)
hidden_rows.declared_cells: declared_cells holds the cells the reconstruction declares at each scored look. They are the cells the scorer compares with the hidden detections, they were fixed before the hidden rows were opened, and they are not part of what the scorer wrote
hidden_rows.reveal_with: POST /api/reconstruct again with the same body and "reveal": true

declared_cells.what: the cells the challenger_blend declares as burning at each scheduled look of the hidden instrument: the cells the blind test compares with the hidden detections of that look, fixed before those are opened

grid.centre_of_a_cell: longitude: box[0] + (column + 0.5) * cell_deg[0]; latitude: box[1] + (ny - row - 0.5) * cell_deg[1]. The grid starts at the south-west corner of the box and may reach a part of a cell past its east and north edges

declared_cells.frame_note: looks[i].frame is the frame of a run that the look is, when the run's frames come from the pass list; null otherwise

held_out_passes_answered_by.words: a challenger model (a blend of a small neural network and boosted decision trees) chosen on fires it was not fitted on, in place of the estimate in use
held_out_passes_answered_by.the_rest: the passes the coarse satellite made, the spread and the frames between passes are the estimate in use

standing_to_the_answering_estimate.why: The challenger was fitted on fires of the fresh test's fitting set of 2018 to 2022; none lies in the places this region's box meets in a year the window touches, and the occupancy values it reads never saw this region in those years. Those places hold 3 fitting fires of 2020 and 2022, other years than the window's.
standing_to_the_answering_estimate.rule: by place and year: a window that touches a test fire's dates is a recorded test fire; then fitted on when a fitting fire of the plan lies in a place the region's context box meets in a year the window touches, or the occupancy values the challenger reads were fitted on the region in such a year; then validated on, by the same rule for the plan's validation fires and the values' validation years; never seen otherwise

model.method: forward and backward occupancy filter on the 375 m grid (backend/model/occupancy.py)

parameters.fitted_on: 22 real fire episodes of 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021 in the plumas_ca, lytton_bc and evia_greece context boxes, the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/episodes.py)

learned_parts.name: reconstruction parameters
learned_parts.detail: fitted values are used: on validation fires they are ahead of both baselines on 2 of 7 scores, tied on 5 and behind on none, beyond the noise of resampling the fires
learned_parts.rule: validation fires are resampled whole (2,000 times); a score is ahead when the 90 percent interval of its improvement over each baseline is above zero, behind when it is below zero against one of them, a tie otherwise. The fitted values are used when no score is behind and at least one is ahead. A part is on when every score of the part is ahead (and, for FRP, the 90 percent interval held for at least 80 percent of validation overpasses); otherwise the part is experimental.
learned_parts.trained_on: 22 real fire episodes of 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021 in the plumas_ca, lytton_bc and evia_greece context boxes, the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/episodes.py)
learned_parts.validated_on: 7 real fire episodes of 2024, 2025 in the same three context boxes (other years than training; none of them a test fire)

learned_parts.name: where the fire is (cells and probabilities)
how many pixels the hidden instrument flags
total fire radiative power and its interval
overlap ratio
learned_parts.detail: a single fitted number used by the overlap-ratio baseline, never by the reconstruction

model.status_reason: 0 of 3 parts of the estimate are on after validation on other fires (model.learned_parts); this run's own blind test is in blind_test.verdict

held_out_passes_estimated_by.chosen: on the fresh test's validation fires, by the rule written before that run (backend/model/challenger/runner.py)
held_out_passes_estimated_by.answers: the held-out passes: their declared cells, their power per cell, the run's blind test headline
held_out_passes_estimated_by.stays_with_the_estimate_in_use: the visible passes, the spread per cell, the belief frames, the exports

model.detection_law: Sofiev and Kouznetsov, Geosci. Model Dev. 19, 10123, 2026, Tables 1 and 2 (re-implemented)

encoding.byte_zero: no fire: the value is exactly zero
encoding.encode: byte = 0 when v is 0; otherwise 1 + round(254 * log10(v / min) / log10(max / min)), kept within 1 to 255
encoding.decode: v = 0 when byte is 0; otherwise min * (max / min) ** ((byte - 1) / 254)

channels.b: MODIS FRP density as observed (only on MODIS frames)
channels.a: VIIRS FRP density as observed (only on VIIRS frames)

encoding.applies_to: all four channels of reconstruction_u8.bin and the density byte of belief_u8.bin, real runs only
encoding.simulated_runs: unchanged: linear, 0 to 80 MW/km2 for r, b and a, 0 to 24 for g
encoding.why: real FRP densities on 375 m cells span about six decades (0.003 to 7,132 MW/km2 in the nine windows measured); on the linear 0 to 80 scale 28 percent of observed cells and 4 percent of reconstructed cells were clipped
encoding.grid: 375 m cells shown on the 256 by 256 tensor grid by nearest cell
encoding.note: counts are 375 m cells over the 24 frames; a cell above the scale is written as the maximum and one below the floor as the floor; epoch_summaries and each frame's mean and max carry the exact values

belief_frames.layout: steps x ny x nx x 2, uint8, C order

channels.name: expected_frp_density
channels.decode: v = 0 when byte is 0; otherwise min * (max / min) ** ((byte - 1) / 254)

belief_frames.view: forward filter only: each step uses the overpasses assimilated up to its time, so the belief spreads between passes and tightens at each one. The 24 payload frames hold the smoothed estimate instead.
belief_frames.assimilated: MODIS only; hidden: VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, VIIRS_SNPP

overview.use: the image drawn when no terrain pack is given
